name: How Ayurveda is Beneficial in Treating Bulged Disc?

sections.overview: How Ayurveda is Beneficial in Treating Bulged Disc?
sections.herbal_remedies:
A bulged disc can commonly be referred to as a protruding disc or a slipped disc but when the disc bulge is significant enough that the disc nucleus comes out of the annulus, it is known as herniated disc. 
A disc bulge may happen due to the great amount of pressure being placed on the disc or if the disc is degenerated due to age factor or other factors. It produces symptoms when it comes in contact with the surrounding tissues or nerves. 
 A bulging disc does not mean that it is a broken disc. The outer wall of the intevertebral disc remains intact but bulged whereas in herniated disc, there is a partial rupture or complete collapse of the outer wall of the intervertebral disc.The primary difference between a bulging disc and herniated disc is that bulging disk does not always affect the entire perimeter of the disk whereas herniated disc protrudes further and is more likely to irritate the nerve roots.
sections.what_are_the_causes_of_bulged_disc:
The degenerative changes in the body as we age is the main cause of bulged disc. Due to aging, daily wear and tear toll takes place in the body which weakens the structures as well as spine. 
 Other Factors Include 

 Injury, strain or accident 
 Obesity 
 Lifting heavy objects 
 Use of back muscles in object lifting
sections.what_are_the_symptoms_of_bulged_disc:
These symptoms usually occur during performing an activity that places enough pressure for the disc to bulge and come in contact with the nearby nerve. 

 Pain in the area of the bulge. 
 Numbness or tingling sensation. 
 Feeling of pain along the nerve pathway into the arms or legs
sections.diagnosis_and_treatment:
Physicians diagnose it by looking at a few different aspects of the pain. The medical history of the patient is also taken along with the physical examination. It is diagnosed by CT scan or MRI. According to modern medicine, if the symptoms are severe and also threaten permanent damage to the spine or its surrounding structures, bulging disc surgery may be required before any conservative methods are attempted. 
 Bulged Disc According to Ayurveda 

 The common perception of the people is that disc bulged once remains bulged for whole life. But, it can become normal with the use of various Ayurvedic herbal remedies. The main aim of the Ayurvedic treatment is to balance the imbalance doshas. 
 According to Ayurveda, bulged disc is a condition that happens due to the imbalance of Vata dosha in the body and Ayurvedic treatment is a good way to restore the basic functional strength of the body.
